verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on Zulip's free-tier limits or whether older message history stays accessible on a free plan. The self-hosting and FOSS mentions describe software parity and free SAML/LDAP, not message-history retention on a free tier, so they cannot be credited to this story.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can keep my team on a free tier without losing access to older message history
